title: ExportLine
description: One NDJSON line emitted by `rebar export` (and rebar.export_tickets): a full compiled ticket object (the TicketState shape) plus a `schema_version` discriminator for the export-line format. NDJSON serves reporting (row-oriented, stream-parseable) and migration (each line re-imports as a full ticket) from one artifact. With `--strip-external`, external-tracker linkage (bridge_alerts, per-comment jira_comment_id, provider keys) is absent. Imported tickets additionally carry provenance (source_id/source_created_at/source_author/source_env). Unknown properties are allowed so the projection can evolve without breaking consumers. WIRE FORM (schema_version 2, bug guilty-pusslike-wyvern): a nanosecond `time.time_ns()` timestamp (created_at/updated_at/comments[].timestamp/signature.signed_at/source_created_at) outside JavaScript's safe-integer range (|n| > 2**53-1 = 9007199254740991) is emitted as its EXACT decimal STRING, not a bare JSON number, per RFC 8259 §6 (a float64 consumer silently rounds a bare 19-digit int). Parse it as an arbitrary-precision integer (`int(x)`/`BigInt(x)`); `rebar import` coerces it back with `int()`. schema_version 1 emitted these as bare numbers.

schema_version.description: Export-line format version (independent of the event-log SCHEMA_VERSION). Bump when the per-line shape changes in a way importers must be aware of.
